extraction_text: Great sages including Parashurama (Rama with the axe) and other ascetics gather to see Bhishma.

Bhishma hears the sages' conversation about him and feels supreme satisfaction, as if in heaven.
The great sages bid farewell to Bhishma and the Pandavas, then disappear from sight.
The Pandavas continue praising the departed sages while the Kuru elders feel comforted and inspired, staying by Bhishma's side.
The Pandavas are amazed by the radiant ascetic power of the sages that illuminated all directions.
Yudhishthira touches Bhishma's feet and asks about dharma, specifically about the purest countries, regions, hermitages, mountains, and rivers.

The two great souls discuss Vedic knowledge and other valuable topics.
The gleaner Brahmin asks the wandering Brahmin the same question about the purest countries, regions, hermitages, mountains, and rivers.
The wandering Brahmin answers that the purest places are those where the Bhagirathi-Ganga, the greatest of rivers, flows.
